items.source: The suppressInterface method can be used to suppress interfaces implemented by the delegate but which should not be introduced to the owning AOP proxy.
items.translation: suppressInterface 方法可用于抑制由代理实现但不应引入到所属 AOP 代理的接口。

items.source:
Subclasses merely need to extend this class and implement the interfaces
to be introduced themselves. In this case the delegate is the subclass
instance itself. Alternatively a separate delegate may implement the
interface, and be set via the delegate bean property.
items.translation: 子类只需继承此类并实现需要由其自身引入的接口。在这种情况下，委托即为子类实例本身。或者，可以有一个单独的委托实现该接口，并通过委托 Bean 属性进行设置。

items.source:
Delegates or subclasses may implement any number of interfaces.
All interfaces except IntroductionInterceptor are picked up from
the subclass or delegate by default.
items.translation: 委托或子类可以实现任意数量的接口。默认情况下，除了 `IntroductionInterceptor` 之外的所有接口都会从子类或委托中获取。

items.source: An instance of this class is serializable if the delegate is.
items.translation: 如果委托是可序列化的，则此类的实例也是可序列化的。

items.source:
Construct a new DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor, providing
a delegate that implements the interfaces to be introduced.
items.translation: 构建一个新的 `DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor`，并提供一个实现了要引入的接口的委托。

items.source:
Construct a new DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor.
The delegate will be the subclass, which must implement
additional interfaces.
items.translation: 构建一个新的 DelegatingIntroductionInterceptor。委托对象将是子类，该子类必须实现额外的接口。

items.source: delegate - the delegate that implements the introduced interfaces
items.translation: delegate - 实现所引入接口的委托

items.source: Proceed with the supplied MethodInterceptor. Subclasses can override this method to intercept method invocations on the target object which is useful when an introduction needs to monitor the object that it is introduced into. This method is never called for MethodInvocations on the introduced interfaces.
items.translation: 继续提供已供应的 MethodInterceptor。子类可以重写此方法来拦截对目标对象的 method 调用，这在需要监控被引入对象时非常有用。此方法永远不会针对引入接口上的 MethodInvocations 被调用。

items.source: Proceed with the supplied MethodInterceptor.

Subclasses may need to override this if they want to perform custom
behaviour in around advice.
items.translation: 子类如果希望在环绕通知中执行自定义行为，可能需要重写此方法。

items.source:
Subclasses may need to override this if they want to perform custom
behaviour in around advice. However, subclasses should invoke this
method, which handles introduced interfaces and forwarding to the target.
items.translation: 子类如果希望在环绕建议（around advice）中执行自定义行为，可能需要重写此方法。然而，子类应调用此方法，该方法负责处理引入的接口并转发到目标。
`invoke` 在接口 `MethodInterceptor` 中

items.source: the result of the call to Joinpoint.proceed(); might be intercepted by the interceptor
items.translation: 调用Joinpoint.proceed()的结果；可能会被拦截器拦截。

items.source: Throwable - if the interceptors or the target object throws an exception
items.translation: Throwable - 如果拦截器或目标对象抛出异常
